This I acknowledge is just, and that the least mixture of sin is an eternal bar to our being justified by our own righteous- ness : but methinks if they could have alleged ihat all their works were essentially and entirely evil, their arguments must have been more effectual, as to the cutting up of self-righteous hopes.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller

author: Andrew Fuller

source_text: I read in the scriptures of the necessity of repentance and con- version ; and many thoughts passed through my mind on this sub- ject; but I generally postponed a serious attention to it to some future day.
claim: 성경에서 회개와 회심의 필요성을 읽었고, 이 주제에 대해 많은 생각을 하였지만, 일반적으로는 심각한 주의를 미래의 어떤 날로 연기하였다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I formed resolutions of amendment, and fixed times when I would return to God by repentance ; but, as the former seldom proved to be of any account in the hour of temptation, so the latter passed over, and left me where I was.
claim: 회개와 개심의 필요성에 대한 성경의 가르침을 읽었지만, 실제로 회개하기 위한 결심과 시도를 하였음에도 불구하고, 유혹의 순간에 그 결심이 무의미해졌고, 결국 이전과 같은 상태로 남아있었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: The words of Christ to Nicodemus would in a manner strike me dead, Ye muftt be born again/ The ideas which I formed of the new birth, as nearly as I can remember, were, that I must be in some very deep distress, next to despair j and in that state of mind a voice from heaven, or something like it. was to set me at liberty.
claim: 새로운 탄생은 깊은 고통과 절망 상태에서 하나님의 음성에 의한 자유를 얻는 것이라고 생각했다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I used to go alone into the fields in an eve- ning, and there weep over my condition, and pray that I might be converted : but it always seemed to me that God would not hear me.
claim: 저자는 하나님께서 자신을 변화시키지 않으실 것이라고 생각하여 절망했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: At length, I began to despair. 1 thought I never should be converted, and so must perish for ever.
claim: 저자는 구원받지 못할 것이라는 절망감에 사로잡혔고, 영원한 멸망을 두려워했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: During this year I was often beset with thoughts like these — ■ * Perhaps, after all, there is nothing in religion ; perhaps the Bible is nothing more than the invention of some great man, to keep the world in order ; perhaps the Mahomedans have as good ground to believe in the Alcoran, as we have in the scriptures ; perhaps there is no hereafter ; perhaps there is no God.' My heart, I believe, would willingly have received these principles, shocking as they are ; but my conscience would not suffer me to do it.
claim: 종교의 진실과 성경의 권위에 대한 의구심이 존재한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I even took pains to convince myself of their falsehood, by walking out into the fields on a starlight evening, viewing the heavens, and inferring from thence the being of a God ; which when admitted, the reality of religion followed as a necessary consequence.
claim: 우주는 하나님의 존재를 암시하며, 하나님의 존재는 종교의 실재성을 의미한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: He said, *' There were some who thought themselves converted, but were not so ; and others, who thought ibey were not converted,
claim: 어떤 사람들은 자신이 회심했다고 생각하지만 실제로는 그렇지 않으며, 다른 사람들은 자신이 회심하지 않았다고 생각한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I thought I must be better than I was : yet how to make myself so, I knew not.
claim: 나는 나 자신을 더 좋은 사람으로 만들고 싶었지만, 방법을 모르겠다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Iniquity, said I, will be my ruin !
claim: 내가 저지른 죄가 나의 파멸이 될 것이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: But, all on a sudden, I seemed to hear as it were a voice from hea- ren, saying to me, Sin shall not have dominion over thee; for thou art not under the law, but under grace.
claim: 죄는 나를 지배하지 못한다. 나는 법 아래 있지 않고 은혜 아래 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In reflecting upon this, I thought, ' I am now surely converted : this must be the new birth.' I was ihe subject of transporting joy, and confidence of having found the pearl of price.
claim: 저는 이제 확실하게 회심했다. 이것이 새 생명이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: true, I could not sin without occasion^il pangs of remorse, and sucb as were very bitter ; but my heart was set on evil.
claim: 내가 죄를 짓고 나서도 내 마음은 악에 집착되어 있었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I drew m.any into my wicked courses, as others had drawn me into theirs ; and having never made any profession of religion, I felt the less concern.
claim: 저는 종교를 실천하지 않았고, 그 결과로 종교에 대한 관심이 줄어들었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I seemed to consider religion as a kind of discretional service.
claim: 종교는 선택적인 서비스로 여겨진다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Those who made profession of it, 1 thought were obli- ged to act accordingly ; but others, except so far as they might be induced to attend to it for their own safety, were at liberty to give scope to their inclinations.
claim: 종교를 신앙으로 공표한 사람들은 그에 따라 행동해야 한다고 생각했지만, 다른 사람들은 자신의 안전을 위해 신앙에 관심을 가질 수 있는 범위 내에서 자신의 성향을 자유롭게 표현할 수 있다고 생각했다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: My heart was so hardened by repeated acts of sin, that God was scarcely in any of my thoughts.
claim: 죄의 반복적인 행위로 인해 내 마음이 경화되어 하나님에 대한 생각이 거의 없었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: From this time, many of my open vices were relinquished : the love of sin, however, was not subdued.
claim: 그의 공개적인 죄들은 많이 버렸지만 여전히 죄를 사랑하는 마음은 남아있었다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In the hour of dejection, I would resolve against future compliances* In some few instances I kept to my resolutions ; and when I did so I had peace ; as also when at any time I had wept over my sin, and bemoaned my miserable condition, I enjoyed a kind of secret satisfaction: but when my resolutions failed me, as they mostly did in the hour of temptation, all my peace and comfort would for- sake me.
claim: 죄를 짓고 나서 후회와 괴로움을 느끼지만, 결심을 지키거나 죄를 통회할 때만 잠시 평안을 얻을 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I have learned by these things, that there is no help in me ; and that, if God were to forgive me all that is past, I should in one hour destroy my soul.
claim: 인간은 스스로 구원할 수 없으며, 하나님의 용서를 받았다 하더라도 인간의 노력만으로는 영혼을 구원할 수 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Fo'merly I used to sin away my convictions ; but have not been able to do so of late.
claim: 저는 과거에는 내 양심을 거스르는 죄를 저지르곤 했지만, 최근에는 그러한 행동을 할 수 없게 되었습니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Conscience has seemed to follow me wher- ever I have gone, or rather, like an angel of God with a drawn sword in his hand, to meet me in my wicked courses.
claim: 양심은 내 모든 행동을 따라다니며, 하나님의 천사처럼 내 악한 길에 서서 나를 만난다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Indeed, I am now afraid of losing my convictions, knowing that eternal ruin must be the consequence in that case, whatever it be as it is.
claim: 영원한 파멸을 피하기 위해서는 자신의 신념을 잃지 않아야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I ajn a miserable sinner.
claim: 저는 불행한 죄인입니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: My crimes have been much tnore numerous and aggravated than you, or any of my friends can have imagined. 1 have long known myself to be a sinner ; but now I feel it.
claim: 저는 더 심각한 죄인이라는 것을 느끼고 있습니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: AK Lord, what have I done !" I sometimes think I feel the wrath of God, as an earnest of hell, kindled already in my bosom.
claim: 저는 때때로 하나님의 진노를 느끼고, 그것이 이미 내 속에 지옥의 예고로 불타고 있다고 생각한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: My former hopes, instead of affor- ding me any encouragement, work despair.
claim: 과거의 소망이 오히려 절망을 가져온다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: It seems to me pre- sumptuous, after so many base and repeated relapses, to hope for mercy.
claim: 저자는 자신의 과거의 실패와 죄로 인해 하나님의 자비를 받을 수 있을지에 대한 희망이 없다고 생각한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: When I look into the scriptures, I see, as I have long 3een, that except I repent, and believe in Christ, I must inevitably perish : but alas, loaded as I am with sorrow, my heart is toe
claim: 구원받기 위해서는 회개하고 그리스도에게 믿음을 가져야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: hard to repent ; and as to faith, and the prayer of faith, they are things foreign from the state of my mind.
claim: 저는 참회와 믿음, 그리고 믿음의 기도를 할 수 없을 것 같아 어려움을 느끼고 있습니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I would give the world, if I had it, to be possessed of them : but O, I cannot, I dare not believe ; I am unworthy of mercy. 1 fear I am a reprobate, of whom God hath determined to make an example, and therefore that there is no hope for me.
claim: 저는 하나님의 자비를 받을 자격이 없으며, 저를 벌하는 예로 삼으려는 하나님의 결정에 따라 구원받을 수 없을 것이라고 믿습니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: My heart has often revolted at that awful doctrine ; and now it overwhelms me. 1 know you will feel for me : but whether any relief can be afforded to a soul like mine, I know not.
claim: 저는 하나님의 심판에 대한 가르침이 너무 두려워서 그것을 받아들이기 어렵다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: My desire and prayer to God for you is, that you may be saved.
claim: 저는 당신이 구원받기를 바라고 기도합니다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: In the early workings of your mind, I see much of the enmity and error of the human heart.
claim: 인간의 마음에는 원래 적개심과 오류가 많다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Your thoughts of God and his government, Christ and his gospel, and of the nature of conversion, are the thoughts of many much older than you : but they are not the better on this account.
claim: 하나님의 정부, 그리스도와 복음, 그리고 회심의 본질에 대한 생각은 나이가 들수록 더 나아지지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: These are among the imaginations and high thoughts that exalt themselves against the knowledge of God, and require to be cast down, and every thought to be brought into subjection to the obedi- ence of Christ.
claim: 하나님의 지식에 대하여 교만하고 높은 생각은 그리스도의 복종에 복종하는 모든 생각을 낮추어야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Your temptations to disbelieve the Bible, and even the being of God, were no more than the ordinary operations of a depraved heart, disturbed by the light of the gospel having made its way into the conscience.
claim: 성경과 하나님의 존재에 대한 의심은 복음의 빛이 양심에 영향을 미치면서 타락한 마음의 普通적인 작용일 뿐이다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Your vows and endeavours to repent and be converted appear to have arisen from a mixture of slavish fear and self-righteous hope.
claim: 회개와 회심을 위한 서약과 노력은 종종 두려움과 자아정당화의 희망의 혼합에서 비롯된다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You was not sorry for your sin, nor wished to be sorry, from any dislike you bore to it ; but you tremble at the wrath to come, and wished to become any thing that you might escape it ; and, not knowing the deceitfulness of your own heart, you flattered yourself that by putting on a good resolution yoH could bend it into a compliance with the will of God.
claim: 진정한 회개는 죄 자체에 대한 싫어함에서 비롯되는 것이 아니라, 오직 심판에 대한 두려움에서 비롯된다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You yourself seem sufficiently convin- ced, by what followed^ that it was not conversion, but a blossom
claim: 그것은 회심이 아니었고, 꽃이 피는 것과 같은 일시적인 감정의 표현이었다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Those who conclude, from such feelings, that they are in a state of salvation, are objects of pity.
claim: 구원 상태에 있는지 판단할 때 감정에 의존해서는 안 된다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Concerning your late and present distress, I feel much for you ; not only in a way of sympathy, but of concern for the issue ; for many persons have been as deeply distressed about their salvation ^s you appear to be, who have yet taken up their rest in something short of Christ ; which is a much more dangerous state than that from which they were first awakened, and, if persisted in, will render their case le^s tolerable than if they had lived and died in ignorance.
claim: 구원에 대한 깊은 고민과 고통을 겪는 사람들 중에도 그리스도보다 다른 것에 안식을 찾는 사람들이 있으며, 이는 더 위험한 상태이고, 만약 계속된다면 처음 깨어났던 상태보다 더 나쁜 결과를 초래할 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Your sins, you say, " are much more numerous and aggravated than I or any of your friends can have imagined." Doubtless you have been guilty of things which neither I nor any other creature can have been privy to : but I apprehend that, at present, you have but a very imperfect sense of them.
claim: 개인은 자신의 죄를 완전히 이해하지 못하고 있으며, 하나님의 관점에서 볼 때 자신의 죄가 훨씬 더 심각하다는 것을 인정해야 한다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: So far from thinking that you view the evil of your way in too strong a light, I am per- suaded you are a thousand times more wicked in the sight of God, whose judgment is according to truth, than ever you have yet been in your own sight : your heart condemns you ; but God is greater than your heart, and knoweth all things !
claim: 하나님의 관점에서 볼 때, 인간은 자신의 죄를 충분히 이해하지 못하며, 하나님의 판단은 진리에 따라 이루어지므로 인간의 죄는 하나님 앞에서 더 심각한 것으로 보인다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: I write not thus to drive you to despair ; for though your sins were ten times more numerous and more aggravated than they are, while the good news of eternal life, through the atonement of Jesus Christ, is held up to you, there is no reason for this.
claim: 예수 그리스도의 속죄를 통해 영생의 복음이 선포되는 한, 죄가 아무리 많고 심각하더라도 절망할 이유는 없다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You have learned, you think, '' that there is no help in you." Be it so, it does not follow that there is none without you On the con- trary, it is by a thorough and practical knowledge of the one, that the other becomes acceptable.
claim: 인간 내부에 도움은 없지만, 예수 그리스도의 대속으로 인해 외부에서 도움을 받을 수 있다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: If the help that is provided with- out, therefore, give you no relief, I am constrained to think it is because you are not yet brought to despair of help from within.
claim: 내적인 도움에 대한 절망이 없으면 외적인 도움도 실제적인 구원으로 이어지지 않는다.

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You may think this to contain no news to you : but I am persuaded that hitherto you have neither understood nor believed it.
claim: 그는 복음에 대해 아직 제대로 이해하거나 믿지 못했다고 주장한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: Your des- pair is like that of a man who gives himself up for lost, without having tried the only remedy.
claim: 절망은 유일한 해결책을 시도하지 않은 채 자기를 잃었다고 생각하는 사람과 같다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
source_text: You have prayed for mercy, but hitherto yon have ashed nothing with a pure respect to the atone-
claim: 구원에 대한 간구는 순수한 마음으로 이루어져야 한다

book: The Works of the Rev. Andrew Fuller, in Eight Volumes — Vol. 4: Dialogues, Letters, and Essays, on Various Subjects
author: Andrew Fuller
